Your Job
Molex is seeking a talented Hardware Electrical Design Engineer to join our Connected Mobility Solutions (CMS) engineering team. In this role, you will contribute to the development of next-generation automotive electronics and wireless charging solutions that power connected and autonomous vehicles. You will collaborate with global cross-functional teams to design innovative, high-quality products from concept through production, ensuring they meet customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and industry-leading performance standards.
Our Team
Connected Mobility Solutions (CMS), a business unit of Molex, develops innovative technologies for automotive in-vehicle networking, infotainment, wireless charging, and lighting applications. Our global engineering teams work closely with customers, manufacturing, quality, and product development specialists to create solutions that enable safer, smarter, and more connected vehicles. We foster a collaborative environment where innovation, continuous learning, and value creation drive success.
What You Will Do
 Design and develop automotive electronic hardware solutions, including wireless charging systems and related technologies.
 Collaborate with global engineering teams to transform customer requirements into innovative product designs.
 Drive hardware development activities from concept, architecture, and prototyping through validation and production release.
 Apply engineering analysis, simulation, and risk assessment techniques to improve product performance and reliability.
 Lead technical discussions and design reviews while providing guidance on design best practices.
 Partner with manufacturing, quality, mechanical, and supplier teams to ensure seamless product development and launch.
 Support customer-facing engineering activities, including validation testing and on-vehicle integration efforts.
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, cost effectiveness, and development efficiency.
 Ensure compliance with automotive standards, customer specifications, and Molex quality management systems.
 Champion innovative solutions that create long-term value for customers and the business.
 Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a related discipline.
 7-12 years of Experience in automotive electronic product design and development.
 Experience with schematic design, PCB development, and hardware validation of electronic systems.
 Working knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, I2C, and SPI.
 Experience using electronic design tools such as Altium Designer or equivalent CAD platforms.
 Knowledge of EMC/EMI design considerations and hardware troubleshooting techniques.
 Experience collaborating within cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
 What Will Put You Ahead
 Experience developing wireless charging or wireless power transfer solutions.
 Knowledge of inductive coil design and wireless power system architectures.
 Experience conducting circuit simulations, Worst Case Circuit Analysis (WCCA), and DFMEA activities.
 Familiarity with automotive product development processes, validation methodologies, and customer design reviews.
 Experience supporting board bring-up, prototype development, and vehicle-level testing.
 Understanding of design for manufacturability, cost optimization, and quality-driven engineering practices.
 Exposure to Six Sigma, ISO standards, APQP, or automotive quality management systems.
 Who We Are
Molex is a subsidiary of Koch Industries, one of the largest privately held companies in the world. Through innovation, engineering excellence, and a commitment to creating value, Molex delivers electronic solutions that enable connectivity across industries including automotive, data communications, consumer electronics, industrial, and medical markets.
Connected Mobility Solutions (CMS), a Molex business unit, develops advanced technologies that support the future of connected and autonomous mobility. Our solutions include high-speed data connectivity, wireless charging, infotainment systems, automotive networking technologies, and intelligent electronic architectures used by leading automotive manufacturers worldwide.
At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value, and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.
At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.
Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

 Proficient in Python

 ISTQB Test certification is a strong plus.

Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive 
 We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
 Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience 
 Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence 
 Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment 
 What You’ll Be Part Of
 As a Advanced Engineer, Audio System Validation, you are responsible for safeguarding system trust across the technology development lifecycle.
You apply deep DSP and system-level expertise to validate algorithmic correctness, detect regression risks, and ensure that measurable performance standards are met throughout development and prior to release.
Operating within the EPIC Validation Team, you contribute primarily by embedding technical validation and automated guardrails directly into development workflows.
 How You’ll Make An Impact
 Perform white-box validation of DSP algorithms and system-level audio processing. 
 Design and execute structured signal-based validation scenarios. 
 Detect artifacts, performance regression, latency issues, and algorithmic instability. 
 Define measurable validation criteria aligned with System Trust standards. 
 Collaborate with developers to integrate repeatable validation checks into CI environments. 
 Analyze complex technical findings and translate them into actionable engineering feedback. 
 Support final validation by providing technical root-cause analysis when required. 
 Contribute to the evolution of automated guardrails and regression protection strategies
 What Makes You A Strong Fit
 Strong background (5+ years) in Digital Signal Processing (DSP), audio algorithms, or embedded audio systems
 Academic background with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Sound Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Signal Processing or equivalent
 Solid understanding of software development workflows and integration environments
 Experience performing white-box technical validation and root-cause analysis. 
 Ability to independently solve moderately complex technical problems. 
 Strong analytical thinking and structured documentation skills
 Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to cross-functional teams
 Bonus Points if You Have 
 Experience integrating automated validation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 Familiarity with performance testing in embedded systems
 Exposure to perceptual audio implications of DSP decisions
 Experience in automotive or resource-constrained systems. 
 Knowledge of measurement tools and signal analysis environments
 Valid driver's license
 Proficiency in on site native language
 Things To Know 
 10% travel might require.  
 Willingness to work in a HARMAN office located in Bengaluru, India   
 Successfully completing a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment  
 What You Can Expect
 A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week. 
 Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others) 
 Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs 
 Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being 
 Tuition reimbursement support 
 Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available 
 An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development 
 You Belong Here 
 HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
 About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology 
 Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
 Important Notice: Recruitment Scams
 Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.

Dans le cadre de l’évolution des plateformes de simulation pour les grands programmes aéronautiques civils et de défense, vous rejoindrez une équipe spécialisée en modélisation et simulation des commandes de vol. Vous serez responsable de l’intégration et de la validation de simulateurs temps réel multi-modèles, utilisés pour le développement, la certification et le training de pilote.
 Votre Activité S'articulera Autour De
 Spécification : Recueillir les besoins auprès des utilisateurs (Bureau d’études commandes de vol, dynamique du vol, simulation) et des parties prenantes ; définir les plans d’intégration et de validation.
 Intégration : intégrer et déployer les modèles de simulation des systèmes commandes de vol sur les plateformes (édition de fichiers de configuration, paramétrage réseau, connexions logiques entre modèles)
 Validation : vérifier et valider l'intégration de l’application logicielle produite, validation fonctionnelle unitaire des modifications modèles commandes de vol et réalisation d’un vol complet sur plateforme de simulation
 Investigation : Analyser les problèmes fonctionnels, en identifier les causes et si besoin faire intervenir les spécialistes systèmes (séances de débug sur plateforme).
 Coordination : Planifier et suivre l’avancement des activités, préparer et animer les points de revue, contribuer aux spécifications et à l’amélioration continue.
 Crosscheck : Comparer et analyser les données de simulation provenant de différents produits de simulation.
 Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation Bac +5 (Université ou Ecole d'ingénieurs) en aéronautique (systèmes, automatisme et contrôle). Vous justifiez de connaissances en systèmes avioniques et en lois de pilotage. Des connaissances spécifiques autour du système commande de vol est apprécié. Un intérêt marqué pour le pilotage est un plus. Pour mener à bien vos activités, vous devrez faire preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur et avoir un bon relationnel.
 Compétences Techniques
 Automatisation des tests (Python, MATLAB/Simulink), CI/CD.
 Gestion de versions (Git), suivi des tickets (Jira).
 UNIX (console, scripts KSH/BASH).
 Connaissances souhaitées : C/Python, réseau bas niveau (ARINC 429, TCP/IP), noyau Linux temps réel.
 Qui sommes-nous ?
 Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. En 2026, pour la 9ème année consécutive, SII France a obtenu le label Great Place To Work®.
Ce succès est le reflet de notre culture basée sur notre volonté de proposer à tous nos salariés un cadre de travail épanouissant pour le développement de leurs compétences et carrières.
Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together !
 Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif.
En tant que société à fortes valeurs humaines, nous sommes signataires de la Charte d'engagement LGBT+ avec l'Association l'autre Cercle et sommes une entreprise Handi-accueillante.
Let’s Tech Together incarne ce que nous sommes et ce que nous aspirons à être : une entreprise dynamique, innovante et humaine. Alors si ces valeurs vous parlent, rejoignez-nous !

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.
As a Propulsion Engineer - Components , you will own the technical follow-up of suppliers and manufacturing partners providing assigned secondary components for a cryogenic rocket engine. These components may include sensors, valves, actuators, mechanisms, or instrumentation hardware supporting the engine.
You will be responsible for ensuring that assigned components are technically mature, tested, qualified, delivered, integrated, and ready to support engine's development and operations. You will work closely with systems engineering, subsystems (pumps, thrust chamber, engine controller), avionics, program management, procurement, quality, PA, supplier quality, AIT/MAIT, test, materials and processes, safety, operations, and the relevant suppliers or manufacturing partners.
Key Responsibilities
 Own the technical follow-up of assigned components during the whole steps from concept to qualification
 Provide hands-on technical support for component design and industrialization, including trade-offs, interface definition, CAD and drawing reviews, design-for-manufacture and assembly, and resolution of technical issues during build and integration.
 Define and maintain the technical baseline for each component, including requirements, interfaces, standards, verification approach, acceptance criteria, configuration, and open technical points.
 Maintain a system-level view of component interfaces and constraints, including mechanical, fluidic, thermal, electrical, command, sensing, cleanliness, materials compatibility, safety, operations, and integration aspects.
 Define and drive development, qualification, acceptance, and integration test strategies, including test objectives, setups, instrumentation, procedures, readiness reviews, execution, data analysis, and closure of findings.
 Review test results and supplier evidence to confirm performance, robustness, lifetime, environmental, interface, safety, production-repeatability, and other applicable requirements are met.
 Define and review relevant test campaigns, including functional performance, leakage, pressure and flow behavior, response time, actuation, thermal and vibration environments, EMC, cleanliness, lifecycle performance, fault conditions, and production repeatability.
 Lead the technical interface with suppliers, manufacturing partners, special-process providers, and test houses, including review of deliverables, drawings, analyses, procedures, inspection evidence, deviations, non-conformances, and test packages.
 Identify, communicate, and manage technical risks, anomalies, and corrective actions, including performance shortfalls, leakage, response issues, cleanliness and materials concerns, lifetime limitations, weak evidence, production variability, delivery risks, and integration constraints.
 Support Engine MAIT/AIT, integration, testing, and operations preparation, including readiness reviews, setup and instrumentation reviews, procedure reviews, test execution, troubleshooting, data assessment, recovery or retest decisions, and the capture of component limitations, monitoring needs, failure responses, and operational constraints.
 What We Would Love To See From You
 Engineering background in aerospace, mechanical, propulsion, fluids, electrical, instrumentation, or a related discipline, with experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, industrial systems, or other safety-critical hardware.
 Experience designing and developing hardware, including CAD, drawings, design reviews, manufacturing, assembly, integration, materials, tolerances, and applicable standards.
 Experience managing the technical follow-up of suppliers and manufacturing partners through development, testing, qualification, delivery, integration, and anomaly resolution.
 Practical knowledge of component requirements, interfaces, verification, qualification, acceptance testing, failure modes, root-cause investigation, and component- or system-level test campaigns.
 Experience supporting AIT or equivalent integration and test activities, and the ability to assess the robustness of designs, manufacturing processes, test approaches, and supplier evidence.
 Familiarity with applicable component standards, design practices, drawings, tolerances, materials, manufacturing processes, and aerospace or industrial standards.
 Ability to work across disciplines, maintain ownership of technical topics, and communicate effectively with engineering, procurement, quality, MAIT/AIT, test, program, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and operations.
 Fluency in English; French and/or German are advantageous.
 Skills and Behaviors
 You keep the technical position clear even when ownership, supplier evidence, schedule, or integration constraints are messy.
 You judge component decisions by their spacecraft mission, safety, integration, cost, and schedule impact.
 You make assumptions, evidence gaps, weak test results, open points, deviations, and emerging risks visible early.
 You use testing and objective evidence to drive decisions, while remaining pragmatic about development speed and available resources.
 You balance fast development with configuration, manufacturing, cleanliness, verification, qualification, and safety discipline.
 You are comfortable going into the detail of a component, its interfaces, its test data, and its failure modes while keeping sight of the overall vehicle.
 You build trust with suppliers, partners, engineers, and leadership through facts, clear decisions, and follow-through.
 Why you should join us!
 What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:
 We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 
 We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them 
 We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? 
 We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.
 The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. 
 All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.
If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

items.jobTitle: Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) – Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems
items.companyName: AIT AUSTRIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY GMBH
items.jobDescription:
As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial contributions to solving the major challenges of our time, climate change and digitalisation. To achieve our goals, we rely on our specific research, development, and technology competencies, which are the basis of our commitment to excellence in all areas. With our open culture of innovation and our motivated, international teams, we are working to position AIT as Austria's leading research institution at the highest international level and to make a positive contribution to the economy and society.
 Our Center for Energy is looking for new Ingenious Partner for our location in Vienna . At the Center for Energy , we work on solutions for the sustainable energy system of the future and, a particular focus lies on the development of power electronics converters for mobile applications (electric vehicles, ships, aviation) as well as grid-tied renewable energy solutions.
 Our team Power Electronics & System Components covers the whole range of power electronics system development from development of novel solutions for the electricity grid, via specification and prototyping towards system test and validation and beyond. With successful collaborative research projects from emerging technologies up to demonstration we position ourselves as a reliable partner for industry.
 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) – Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems
 CENTER FOR ENERGY 
 As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV.
 You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures.
 You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components.
 You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools.
 You define power-stage architectures , including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures.
 You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration.
 You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines.
 You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware.
 You work on research and development projects , prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues.
 You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders.
 You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.
 Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: 
 Master’s or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
 Several years of experience in power electronic systems
 Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies.
 Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management.
 Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred)
 Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems.
 Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis
 Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems
 Very good English skills (spoken and written); German skills are a nice to have.
 What to expect: 
 The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 61.334,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions (incl. Home-Office) and individual training and career opportunities.
 Mentorship and training in embedded firmware and power systems
 The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge power converter technologies in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment.
 At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.
 Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates and documents, as well as a proof of identity.

Das Fraunhofer IKTS betreibt anwendungsorientierte Forschung für Hochleistungskeramik. Die drei Standorte in Dresden und Hermsdorf (Thüringen) formen das größte Keramikforschungsinstitut Europas. Als Forschungs- und Technologiedienstleister entwickeln wir moderne keramische Hochleistungswerkstoffe, industrierelevante Herstellungsverfahren sowie prototypische Bauteile und Systeme in vollständigen Fertigungslinien bis in den Pilotmaßstab. Darüber hinaus umfasst das Portfolio die Kompetenzen Werkstoffdiagnose und -prüfung.
 In der Arbeitsgruppe »Multifunktionale Werkstoffe und Bauteile« werden neue funktionskeramische Werkstoffe und Komponenten für Anwendungen in der Sensorik, Aktorik, Ultraschalltechnik und Leistungselektronik entwickelt. Dabei stehen smarte Werkstoff- und Systemlösungen im Vordergrund industriell und öffentlich geförderter Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte.
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Ziel der Bachelor-/Master-/Diplomarbeit ist die Entwicklung piezokeramischer Schlicker und einer Technologie zur Herstellung piezokeramischer Fasern. Diese sind Grundlage für die spätere Fertigung von Ultraschallwandlern für Medizintechnik und zerstörungsfreie Werkstoffprüfung.
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Sie sind Student*in der Werkstoffwissenschaft, Chemie, Verfahrenstechnik oder eines vergleichbaren Studienganges.  
 Zusätzlich runden folgende Kompetenzen und Fertigkeiten Ihr Profil ab: 
 Gute Studienleistungen
 Experimentelles Geschick und Grunderfahrungen im Chemielabor
 Selbstständige, engagierte und systematische Arbeitsweise
 Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 Ihre Fähigkeiten des wissenschaftlichen Arbeitens werden geschult sowie gefördert und Sie erhalten Einblicke in die Bearbeitung und den Ablauf von Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte. Sie werden durch erfahrene wissenschaftliche Mitarbeitende betreut und erhalten ideale Rahmenbedingungen für Praxiserfahrungen neben dem Studium.
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 
 Die monatliche Arbeitszeit beträgt ca. 32 Stunden in Abstimmung mit der Fachabteilung. 
 Die Stelle ist auf 6 Monate befristet. 
 Wir weisen darauf hin, dass die gewählte Berufsbezeichnung auch das dritte Geschlecht miteinbezieht. 
 Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft legt Wert auf eine geschlechtsunabhängige berufliche Gleichstellung. 
 Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der Gesamtbetriebsvereinbarung zur Beschäftigung der Hilfskräfte. 
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.  
 Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt, und machen Sie einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Ihrer Online-Bewerbung erhalten Sie eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Ihnen, wie es weitergeht.

Du möchtest in einer der führenden Steuerkanzleien in Düsseldorf tätig sein und die Kanzlei bei Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und stabilen IT-Prozessen unterstützen? 
 Wir suchen Entwickler:in für Automatisierung vor Ort (n8n / Zapier / Make) (m/w/d) , die unser Team in Automatisierung , Prozessaufnahme, Systemeinführung, Schnittstellenanbindung und im IT-Betrieb zuverlässig unterstützen. Während der Einarbeitung lernst du unsere digitale Arbeitsweise, das Dokumenten- und Fristenmanagement sowie unsere Automatisierungs- und DATEV-Systeme kennen. 
 Deine täglichen Aufgaben: 
 Betreuung der eingesetzten SaaS-Anwendungen (User-/Lizenzverwaltung, Konfiguration, Berechtigungen) 
 Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software 
 Dokumentation und Konzeption digitaler Geschäftsprozesse (SOPs, Checklisten) 
 Planung und Einführung neuer Software- und IT-Lösungen 
 Verbinden von Standardlösungen über Schnittstellen 
 Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben (z. B. Zapier/Mirror/ähnliche Tools) 
 Anwenderschulung und -betreuung (First/Second Level), Erstellung von Leitfäden 
 Fehleranalyse und Störungsbeseitigung über Ticketsystem 
 DATEV-Support-Themen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Dienstleistern 
 Zusätzliche Aufgaben (je nach Erfahrung) 
 System- und Rechteverwaltung, Basis-Administration (Benutzer, Endgeräte) 
 Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups) 
 Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management 
 Ausbau von Low-Code/No-Code-Automationen mit n8n, Zapier, Make 
 Prozessoptimierung und Projektmanagement in enger Abstimmung mit Fachabteilungen 
 Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:
 Klare Strukturen und Prozesse:
 Bei uns findest du eine eindeutige Aufgabenverteilung, standardisierte Abläufe und dokumentierte Prozesse. Du erhältst praxisbewährtes Fachwissen und kannst dich auf eine planbare Einarbeitung verlassen. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind klar definiert und nachvollziehbar.  
 Attraktive Vergütung:
 Du erhältst von Beginn an ein überdurchschnittliches, festes Gehalt. Zusätzlich gibt es je nach Stelle transparente und messbare Bonusregelungen für besonders gute Leistungen. 
 Professionelle Mandate:
 Du arbeitest in einer der führenden Kanzleien in Düsseldorf und hilfst bei der Betreuung von renommierten Mandanten. Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit. 
 Sicherer Arbeitsplatz
 Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Wir haben nur unbefristete Arbeitsverträge in Vollzeit. Durch unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und die stabile Auftragslage bieten wir dir eine langfristige Perspektive mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit. 
 Hochmodernes Büro:
 Du arbeitest bei uns in einem voll verglasten Büro mit atemberaubender Aussicht über Düsseldorf und mit den neuesten Geräten. Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen. 
 Digitale Arbeitswelt:
 Wir arbeiten vollständig digital, sind von DATEV als Digitale Kanzlei ausgezeichnet und nutzen automatisierte Prozesse, damit du dich auf deine Kernaufgaben konzentrieren kannst. Wir sind eine innovative Kanzlei im Bereich Digitalisierung. 
 Eckdaten zur Stelle: 
 Gehalt: 48.000 - 54.000 Euro (brutto) Jahresgehalt
 Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: vorhanden
 Einarbeitungsphase: in der Regel 2–4 Monate
 Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z. B. IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau , Informatikkaufmann/-frau ) oder Studium ( Wirtschaftsinformatik o. ä.) 
 Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Support, IT-Administration oder Software-Implementierung 
 Erfahrung mit Integrations-/Automation-Tools (z. B. Zapier, Mirror/Make o. ä.) und Routine im DATEV-Umfeld 
 Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office ; Erstellung/Pflege von Formularen und Dokumenten 
 Sehr gute Ausdrucksform in Wort und Schrift; hohe Verlässlichkeit und Diskretion 
 Strukturierte , vorausschauende und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise; souverän in dynamischen Situationen 
 Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und serviceorientiertes Auftreten 
 Von Vorteil: Grundverständnis für Online-Marketing/Consulting-Prozesse

About Rohlik Group
 Rohlik Group is Europe's leading online grocery delivery service. Using technology, we deliver a weekly shop of 25,000 SKUs in under three hours, in 15-minute delivery slots — giving our customers back their time, freedom and flexibility.
 We believe the world needs a better food system: more sustainable, more inclusive, and bringing healthier, more personalised food to everyone. In every city we operate, we handpick the best and freshest local produce — from butchers to bakeries — and work directly with farmers through our Farm-to-Door program, alongside the trusted brands and affordable own-label products our customers love.
 About the Team
 The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.
 The Role
 As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network — from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Your projects will span both hardware (robotics, automated material handling, conveyor and packing systems) and software (control logic and orchestration optimisation), using whichever combination best solves the problem.
   What We Offer
 Unlimited Vacation: Unlimited vacation days for a balanced work-life balance
 Tax-Free Benefits: Monthly vouchers of €45 tax-free (via become.1)
 Remote Allowance: €20 monthly allowance towards internet costs
 Exclusive Shopping Perk: Knuspr Xtra account with 10% cashback in the form of Knuspr Credits
 Corporate Discounts: Great discounts via CorporateBenefits (fitness, travel, tickets, shopping, and much more)
   What You'll Do
 Identify improvement potential across the fulfillment network — on the floor, in the data, and with operations teams — wherever automation or process redesign can meaningfully improve cost, throughput, quality or safety
 Own the business case for each opportunity: quantify throughput gains and labour impact, calculate payback period, prepare capex/opex estimates, and defend the investment to senior stakeholders
 Own the full solution end to end, whatever form it takes — physical automation, software/control changes, or a combination of both
 Standardise delivered work into reusable templates, playbooks and best practices that accelerate future projects
 Lead implementation from design through testing, installation, integration and piloting, coordinating internal teams, vendors and contractors to deliver a working solution on site
 Partner with Procurement and Operations across the full lifecycle — from requirements, RFIs/RFQs, vendor evaluation and commercial negotiation, through to a clean handover with documentation, SOPs, support processes and training for operational teams
 Feed insights from delivered projects into the group automation roadmap and warehouse planning concepts
 Support site and regional leadership by translating process and performance data into prioritised improvement opportunities
 What We're Looking For
 Required: 
 Degree in engineering, a technical/analytical field (e.g., mechanical, mechatronics, industrial engineering, logistics), or an equivalent completed vocational training (Ausbildung) / relevant hands-on experience
 3+ years of experience in warehouse automation (e.g., robotics, AMRs, AutoStore, sorters, conveyors, packing systems) and process improvement, including end-to-end project ownership from concept to handover
 Strong analytical skills, capable of both spreadsheet business modeling and floor-level process evaluation
 Proven project management ability to align Operations, Engineering, Finance, and external vendors
 Strong negotiation and engagement skills with third-party vendors and contractors
 Broad interest in both the hardware and software sides of automation
 Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken)
 Willingness to spend regular time on-site at fulfillment centers
 Nice to have: 
 Familiarity with control logic, orchestration software or WMS integration
 Working knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies

About Exa
 We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion. 
 Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. 
 We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.
 About the Role
 Thousands of developers and companies use Exa on pay-as-you-go. As the Support Engineer for PAYGO, you own all of their inbound questions: getting started, search quality, billing, errors, integrations, and real bugs. The volume is high and every day is different.
 It's one of the fastest ways to learn Exa end to end. You'll work with our AI support tools, the docs, Product and Engineering, and you'll see what developers build with Exa before anyone else does. Some of the people writing in are tomorrow's biggest customers, and you'll be the one who spots them.
 In this role, you will:
 Own the PAYGO queue : answer what the AI first line can't, quickly and clearly
 Debug with customers : reproduce issues with the API, read their code and send working fixes
 Triage well : production issues and unhappy customers first, everything else in order
 Escalate with full context : bugs to Engineering, product gaps to Product, and anything you can't resolve to the Support leader
 Spot growth : flag PAYGO accounts that look like future enterprise customers to Sales
 Improve the AI first line : fix the docs, help center and agent workflows so the same question doesn't need a human twice
 Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback
 Requirements
 Programming experience: you can read unfamiliar code, call an API and debug a failing request
 Clear, short writing. Customers can act on your answers without coming back
 You learn fast and keep quality high when the volume is high
 Good judgment on what to answer yourself and what to escalate
 Comfort working AI-first, with AI tools and agents as part of your daily workflow
 Early-career candidates are welcome
 You might excel if you...
 Have worked in support, developer relations or a customer-facing technical role at a developer-tools, API or AI company
 Have built side projects with LLMs, RAG or agents
 Enjoy being the person who finally figures out what's going on
 Want to grow into an FDE or Solutions Architect role over time
 Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines
 This is a remote role based in the US. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.
 Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
 Compensation: $115K – $225K • Offers Equity

🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB. 
 Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.
 Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.
 Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.
 Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich.
 💡 DEINE MISSION 
 Im Krankenhaus dokumentieren Pflegekräfte mit voize direkt am Bett. Die freigegebenen Einträge landen strukturiert im KIS, über unsere Integration mit ORBIS U von Dedalus. Damit ist Pflegedokumentation nicht nur Grundlage guter Pflege, sondern auch Grundlage für Kodierung, Abrechnung und MD-Prüfungen. Abgerechnet werden kann nur, was belegt ist.
 Genau hier brauchen wir deinen Blick aus dem Medizincontrolling. Als Care Expert berätst du Kliniken, wie ihre Pflegedokumentation aufgebaut sein muss, damit erbrachte Leistungen vollständig und prüfsicher in der Akte stehen. Mit den strengeren MD-Prüfquoten ab 2027 wird das für viele Häuser zur wirtschaftlichen Frage. Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Medizincontrolling, Pflegedirektion, Stationsleitungen und Klinik-IT. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Pflegekräfte Zeit gewinnen und die Dokumentation zugleich den Anforderungen von Kodierung und Prüfung standhält.
 🚀 DEIN ALLTAG 
 Dokumentation verstehen, bevor es zählt: Vor dem Go-live analysierst du mit Medizincontrolling, Pflege und Klinik-IT, wie die Pflegedokumentation im KIS aufgebaut ist, von Assessments wie ePA-AC und Barthel über LEP-Maßnahmen bis zu Vitalwerten, Bilanzierung und Wunddokumentation.
 Die Erlös- und Prüfperspektive einbringen: Du zeigst, welche pflegerischen Inhalte für die Rechtfertigung der Verweildauer, Nebendiagnosen, Komplexbehandlungen wie die geriatrische frührehabilitative Komplexbehandlung und die MD-Prüfung relevant sind, und wo heute Informationen auf dem Weg in die Akte verloren gehen.
 Zwischen Pflege, Medizincontrolling und System übersetzen: Anforderungen aus Kodierrichtlinien und Prüfverfahren machst du für Pflegeteams greifbar, und Pflegealltag für das Medizincontrolling.
 Wirkung sichtbar machen: Gemeinsam mit den Kliniken legst du fest, woran sich Dokumentationsqualität messen lässt, und unterstützt bei ROI-Workshops mit Geschäftsführung und Medizincontrolling.
 Sauber einordnen: Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet, findest du heraus, ob es an der KIS-Konfiguration, am Prozess auf Station oder am Produkt liegt. Deine Einschätzung geht klar an Customer Success, Support und Product, und du bringst die Sicht des Medizincontrollings in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Krankenhaus-Produkts ein.
 Kliniken begleiten: Remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort begleitest du Einführungen über den Go-live hinaus, eng abgestimmt mit dem zuständigen Customer Success Manager.
 Wissen aufbauen, das skaliert: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Playbooks, Checklisten und interne Enablements für den Krankenhausbereich, etwa zu DRG-Grundlagen und MD-Prüfungen für unsere Kolleg:innen.
 🤝 DEIN PROFIL 
 Du hast mindestens eine Weiterbildung zur Medizinischen Kodierfachkraft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und Praxis im Medizincontrolling eines Krankenhauses. Erfahrung als Medizincontroller:in ist ein großes Plus.
 Du bist sicher im aG-DRG-System, in ICD-10-GM, OPS und den Deutschen Kodierrichtlinien und kennst die Abläufe rund um MD-Prüfungen und die Prüfverfahrensvereinbarung aus eigener Fallbearbeitung.
 Idealerweise bringst du einen pflegerischen Grundberuf mit, etwa in der Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege, und weißt, wie Dokumentation auf Station wirklich entsteht.
 Du hast mit einem KIS gearbeitet, am liebsten mit ORBIS von Dedalus. Pflegerische Assessments und Leistungserfassung wie ePA-AC oder LEP sind dir vertraut oder du arbeitest dich schnell ein.
 Systeme sind für dich Werkzeug, kein Hindernis. Du denkst in Abhängigkeiten und Ursachen und bleibst dran, bis du verstehst, warum etwas so ist.
 Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, einer Pflegedirektion genauso wie einer Pflegekraft im Spätdienst oder der Geschäftsführung einer Klinik.
 Du arbeitest gern beratend und strukturiert. Du gibst klare Empfehlungen und vertrittst sie auch.
 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Auf Englisch solltest du dich sicher verständigen können, weil ein Teil der internen Zusammenarbeit auf Englisch läuft.
 Du bist gern bei unseren Kunden. Termine vor Ort gehören regelmäßig dazu, der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft remote.
 🌱 GEMEINSAM WACHSEN – DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI voize 
 Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Startup. Du übernimmst neue Themen, wächst schnell und bewirkst etwas, das Pflegekräften mehr Zeit für die Menschen gibt.
 Du gestaltest mit: Unser Krankenhausbereich wächst gerade, und du prägst, wie wir Kliniken fachlich begleiten.
 Wir leben eine offene, kollaborative Kultur mit regelmäßigen Team-Events, ob du aus unserem Berliner Office arbeitest oder remote aus Deutschland.
 Mit Stock Options wirst du Teil unseres Erfolgs.
 30 Urlaubstage plus dein Geburtstag frei, Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, regelmäßige Company-Offsites sowie Zugang zu Lernplattformen wie Blinkist und Audible.
 Du entscheidest, wann du am besten arbeitest: flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein gutes Hybrid-Setup.
 ✨ LUST AUF EIN GESPRÄCH? JETZT BEWERBEN. 
 Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen, ganz gleich, wer du bist und welchen Hintergrund du mitbringst.

Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Justice.
 DEINE MISSION 
 Als Kubernetes Administrator/Private Cloud Engineer (m/w/d) stellst du sicher, dass unsere Container-Infrastruktur reibungslos läuft und zukunftsfähig bleibt. Deine Mission ist es, eine hochverfügbare, skalierbare und sichere Plattform zu schaffen, auf der unsere Anwendungen zuverlässig betrieben und weiterentwickelt werden können. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team treibst du die Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Cloud-Umgebung voran.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Beratung, Konzeption und Implementierung von Private Cloud Plattformen
 Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren Fachteams zur Bereitstellung der nötigen Infrastruktur
 Messung, Analyse und Optimierung der Performance und Stabilität
 Aufbau und Betrieb verteilter Systeme unter Anwendung des DevOps-Ansatzes
 Förderung von Continuous Integration & Deployment-Prozessen für eine effiziente und schnelle Bereitstellung der Lösungen
 Fehleranalyse und -behebung in Container-Umgebungen
 DAS IST UNS WICHTIG 
 Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Cloud-/Plattformbetrieb
 Erfahrung in der agilen Entwicklung und im Betrieb von verteilten Systemen
 Fundierte Kenntnisse in Kubernetes und Ansible sind unerlässlich
 Erfahrung in der Fehleranalyse und -behebung in Container-Umgebungen
 Erfahrung in Konfiguration und Betrieb sowie in der Entstörung von Proxies
 Ein tiefes Verständnis für DevOps-Praktiken ist von Vorteil
 Erfahrungen mit CI/CD-Pipelines OpenShift und mit JavaEE sind ein Plus
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sowie Englischkenntnisse auf Konversationsniveau

Wir bei flaconi sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt Kreativität, Innovation und Wachstum fördert. Sie lebt in all ihren Formen der Schönheit. Unser Team ist ein Mosaik von Einzelpersonen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Kulturen und Lebenswegen, die alle durch eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft für Schönheit vereint sind. Unser Engagement basiert auf unseren Grundwerten , insbesondere #trustinpeople . Wir sehen es als unsere Verantwortung an, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich jeder Mitarbeitende ehrlich wertgeschätzt und gehört fühlt und dazu ermutigt wird, seine einzigartigen Perspektiven einzubringen, um ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit zu fördern.
 flaconi ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit und begrüßt und ermutigt alle qualifizierten Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten jeglicher Herkunft und Identität zur Bewerbung, unabhängig von ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Rasse, Geschlechtsidentität, Migrationshintergrund, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderungsstatus, sexueller Orientierung, Religion oder Alter.
 Solltest du spezielle Unterstützung während des Bewerbungs- oder Interviewprozesses benötigen – z. B. Live-Untertitelung, mehr Zeit für das Interview oder die Aufgabe in einem anderen Format – lass es uns einfach wissen, damit wir den Prozess entsprechend anpassen können. Wir werden unser Bestes tun, um dies zu ermöglichen.
 Als Mechatroniker:in in der Intralogistik bist du für die Wartung, Reparatur und Instandhaltung von Lager- und Fördertechnik verantwortlich. Du sorgst dafür, dass alle Maschinen reibungslos funktionieren, z.B. indem du Störungen behebst. Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für Technik hast, ist diese Position genau das Richtige für dich! 
 Deine Rolle 
 Du übernimmst die Planung und Überwachung von Wartungen, Inspektionen und kleinen Instandsetzungen an gebäudetechnischen Anlagen.
 Des Weiteren gehört auch die Bedienung und Beseitigung von Störungen an haustechnischen Anlagen wie z.B. Rolltore, Fördertechnik, Türen, Sanitär, Bodyscanner und Automatisierungsanlagen zu deinen Aufgaben.

 Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry
 $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

 Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.
 The role 
 A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.
 You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

 We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

 You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.
 You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.
 You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.
 You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

items.jobTitle: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
items.jobDescription:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. 
 Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. 
 This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. 
 The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. 
 A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program. 
 In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems. 
 The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.
 Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated. 
 Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics. 
 Starting dates: Fall 2026

 Anglais requis : beaucoup de collaborateurs sont anglophones. Ton binôme est francophone.

 ~4-5 ans d'expérience minimum en dev, sur des projets réellement mis en production.
 Expérience de Tech Lead ou équivalent : tu as déjà drivé des décisions d'architecture et d'infra, tu sais arbitrer entre vélocité et dette.
 Pratique concrète et récente des LLMs : tu as essayé des choses, poussé des expérimentations, testé Claude / OpenAI / Mistral. Tu es moteur sur ces sujets, pas suiveur.
 Python et TypeScript dans ta boîte à outils. Le langage compte moins que ta capacité à choisir le bon outil pour le bon problème.

 Capacité à livrer vite et à prioriser ce qui a réellement de l'impact — mode Doer, pas mode powerpoint.

 Anglais professionnel courant.

 LLMs : Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI, Mistral — l'équipe n'est pas mono-provider, tu choisis le bon modèle pour le bon usage.

 Un cadre ultra-responsabilisant : autonomie, ownership, décisions techniques à ton niveau.

 Job Description: 
 Role Purpose & Value 　 
 Liaison with customer (Japan OEM), acting as technical Interface between customer and　GKN ECU software team. Lead customer interface ECU Software　reporting, open issue tracking, timeline management, and escalation management.
 To strengthen our engineering team we are looking for a software Engineer to be a resident engineer at a large vehicle OEM. Your key responsibilities will be contributor and support of low voltage power electronics designs for application to Electronic Control Units and be the Lead Customer Interface, understanding, analyzing and managing customer change needs and requests relating to electrical software and execution feasibility. Your ability to speak both Japanese and English at business level will be important as this you will need to analyze, link, and distribute customer needs the GKN electrical software design and test team.
 Tasks and areas of responsibility: 
 Verify and if needed, debug the overall base software, e.g E- Electrical Diagnostics 
 Support the development team by architectural and detailed designs including Technical Safety Concept for Software and CyberSecurity related content (Specifications, etc.) 
 Support SW-PL on detailed planning and customer coordination 
 Interface with the customer on vehicle design FMEAs and diagnostics interfaces 
 Reporting /Meeting/explanation/Presentation within OEM 
 Support and debug software issues in the lab and at customer through commissioning, testing, diagnosing, and inspection through development life cycle 
 Support release electrical software design outputs from ECAD tools according to GKN processes, and facilitate customer releases 
 Understanding of Tests of ECU software 
 Preferable : Understanding ECU Hardware 
 Internal training 
For 1st year before working at OEM, require basic technical training at Daikoji Technical Canter in Japan.

 Engineering degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent 
 Customer management experience

 Automotive SW Know How (e.g. Communication Protocols, Diagnostics, AUTOSAR, MISRA, ...) 
 Basic Electrics, Electronics and Microcontroller Know How Good

 Language

 About Dauch: 
 Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries - GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward.  Project Description 
We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic student assistant to join our research group assisting our project work. The research group Research for Sustainable Energy Technologies - RESET consists of experts focusing on the environmental, economic, and social aspects of cutting-edge sustainable energy technologies. 
Responsibilities 
Data Visualization: Collaborate with our group for research data visualization. Create clear and informative charts, graphs and visual elements including creative design for posters, reports and postings.
Supporting Organization and Communication of research results: Assist in organizing workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Coordinate logistics, invitations, and materials required for the events.
Literature Research (potentially): Conduct research to gather relevant scientific articles, reports, and studies. Summarize findings and provide critical input to our projects.
Qualifications 
You have data visualization expertise and graphical design creativity, strong organizational abilities, and a collaborative mindset to contribute to our research activities, while being enthusiastic about sustainability and energy transition research. You are able to communicate in English, German language skills are appreciated. 
What we offer
We provide a learning opportunity in sustainability assessment and energy technology research, with a long-term perspective for students interested in conducting graduation projects in the field of sustainability assessment under our supervision. 
Enjoy flexible hours and be part of an interdisciplinary, supportive environment where you can make a positive impact. A workplace at the Karlsruhe city center directly at Europaplatz.
